sources.note: Neutrik powerCON TRUE1 (NAC3FX-W-TOP class) is built in the same round housing as powerCON and speakON: same box (NL4FXX STEP bounding box 26.83 x 30.34 x 79.25 mm) with a light grey housing (the powerCON out / TRUE1 colour) and three contact holes. The TRUE1 drawing was not opened: the shared box is an assumption.
